cards.label: Zeus
cards.general: Zeus is the ruler of the gods, son of Cronus and Rhea.
cards.here: He fathers Apollo and Artemis with Leto, and Hebe, Ares, and Eileithyia with Hera. He brings Athena forth from his own head.

evidence.greek: Ἥρη δʼ Ἥφαιστον κλυτὸν οὐ φιλότητι μιγεῖσα
evidence.reason: Hera bears Hephaestus without union, so he is excluded from the children Zeus fathers here.
